payload.reason: The evidence provides specific results from the experiments conducted on the new dataset for fine-grained sentiment analysis, including performance metrics such as precision, recall, and F1 scores.

claims.text: The baseline model achieved Proportional F1 scores of .41, .31, and .31 for Holders, Targets, and Polar Expressions, respectively, and Binary F1 scores of .41, .36, and .56.
The domain variation led to a lower overlap between training and test data, with overlaps of 56%, 28%, and 50% for Holders, Targets, and Polar Expressions, respectively.
The dataset introduced, NoReC_fine, is the first for fine-grained sentiment analysis in Norwegian, providing benchmarks for further experiments.
